messages.subject: Rename QTL when plotting
parts:
Is there a way to rename the QTL when you are plotting on a genetic map. Instead of a sequential Q1,Q2....Q10, is it possible to give a string of custom names, like "gene 1" "gene 2".....etc.?

I essentially have the locations of ~40 homologs included in 3 gene families that I want to plot

plot(qtl2,col=path$colors)


Gene family 1 is colored red and has 10 "QTL" locations

Gene family 2 is colored blue and has 15 "QTL" locations"

Gene family 3 is colored yellow and has 20 "QTL" locations


I didn't see anything on these forums or in the manual. I can think of a few workarounds, but they are a little above my coding level and I'd have to modify the plotMap() function to an extent above my skills again.

messages.author: 96353e7106735838
messages.subject: Re: [Rqtl-disc] Rename QTL when plotting
parts:
When you create the qtl object with makeqtl, indicate the names as a vector, with the argument qtl.name.
In the call to plot(), indicate the colors by giving a vector with the argument col.

Here's an example:

data(hyper)
hyper <- calc.genoprob(hyper, step=1)
qtlnames <- paste0("gene", 1:5)
qtl <- makeqtl(hyper, chr=c(1,1,4,6,15), c(25, 49, 29, 21, 63),
qtl.name=qtlnames, what="prob")

plot(qtl, col=c("blue", "red", "green", "blue", "green"))

karl
